nodes.name: POM synthesis by heated reflux
nodes.procedure: a unique Keggin-type phosphomolybdate H6PMo9V3O40·xH2O (referred to as POM) with three vanadium substitutions was prepared using a heated reflux method as the precursor. According to the literature, a heated reflux method was used to synthesize the polyoxometalate precursor.

nodes.name: Fe-doped NiCo2O4 on NF
nodes.procedure: Fe doping was performed on the spinel structure of NiCo2O4 by a simple hydrothermal method to prepare an in situ grown Fe0.2Ni0.8Co2O4/NF 3D nanoflower structure on a nickel foam substrate. The reaction involved hydrothermal and calcination processes to prepare Fe0.2Ni0.8Co2O4 nanoflowers on nickel foam.

nodes.characterization_summary: SEM shows uniform growth of 3D nanoflowers with diameter ≈3 μm on nickel foam substrate for POM-FNCO/NF.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The SEM micrograph showed the uniform growth of 3D nanoflowers on the foam nickel substrate (Figure 2a). SEM images at different magnifications (Figure 2b,c) revealed the presence of numerous nanoflowers with a diameter of ≈3μm on the nickel foam substrate...

nodes.characterization_summary: TEM shows uniform anchoring of POM on the surface of FNCO for POM-FNCO.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Transmission electron microscopy (TEM) and high-resolution transmission electron microscopy (HRTEM) further characterized the internal structure and surface morphology of POM-FNCO. Figure 2d,e shows the uniform anchoring of POM on the surface of FNCO.

nodes.characterization_summary: HRTEM shows crystal lattice stripes of 0.204 nm and 0.205 nm corresponding to NiCo_2O_4 {311} and Fe_3O_4 {311} planes respectively.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Furthermore, the HRTEM and selected area electron diffraction (SAED) patterns exhibit crystal lattice stripes of 0.204 and 0.205 nm (Figure S2, Supporting Information), corresponding to the characteristic crystal lattice planes of NiCo_2O_4 {311} and Fe_3O_4 {311} respectively (Figure 2e-f).

nodes.characterization_summary: EDS shows uniform distribution of P, Mo, O, V, Fe, Ni, and Co elements in POM-FNCO/NF.
nodes.evidence_snippet: In addition, EDS analysis was performed on POM-FNCO/NF, and the results (Figure 2h-n; Figure S3, Supporting Information) showed a uniform distribution of P, Mo, O, V, Fe, Ni, and Co elements in the composite material...

nodes.characterization_summary: FNCO shows peaks at 18.9°, 31.1°, 36.7°, 38.4°, 44.6°, 59.1°, 64.9° corresponding to NiCo_2O_4 {111}, {220}, {311}, {222}, {400}, {511}, {440} planes. POM-FNCO shows additional peaks at 8.16°, 9.06°, 16.02°, 17.58°, 21.64°, 27.94°, 30.9° indicating POM clusters.
nodes.evidence_snippet: In Figure 3b, the spectra of Fe_{0.2}Ni_{0.8}Co_2O_4 show salient peaks at 18.9°, 31.1°, 36.7°, 38.4°, 44.6°, 59.1°, and 64.9°, corresponding to the {111}, {220}, {311}, {222}, {400}, {511}, and {440} planes of NiCo_2O_4 crystal (PDF#20-0781)... However, the XRD spectrum of POM-Fe_{0.2}Ni_{0.8}Co_2O_4 shows additional diffraction peaks at 8.16°, 9.06°, 16.02°, 17.58°, 21.64°, 27.94°, and 30.9°...

nodes.characterization_summary: POM shows peaks at 1062.6, 964.5, 867.8, 786 cm^{-1} corresponding to P-O_a, Mo=O_t, Mo-O_b-Mo, Mo-O_c-Mo vibrations of Keggin-type PMo_{12}. POM-FNCO shows peaks at 1062, 967, 870, 785 cm^{-1} confirming POM anchoring.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The FT-IR spectrum (Figure 3b) shows unique peaks of POM at 1062.6, 964.5, 867.8, 786 cm^{-1}, corresponding to the asymmetric stretching vibration of v_as (P-O_a) and v_as (Mo=O_t), the angular sharing vibrations of v_as (Mo-O_b-Mo), and the edge-sharing vibrations of v_as (Mo-O_c-Mo) of the Keggin-type PMo_{12} heteropolyacid... The characteristic peaks of POM-FNCO at 1062, 967, 870, and 785 cm^{-1} further confirm the anchoring of POM in the composite.

To further investigate the surface chemical state and oxidation state of POM-FNCO, X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS) tests were conducted to characterize the presence of Ni, Co, Fe, Mo, V, and O elements (Figure 3c).
